preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n_i <= 10**9 for n_i in n_list)
all(1 <= k_i <= 10**18 for k_i in k_list)

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line in ['YES', 'NO'] for output_line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line == 'YES' if k_i >= 2**(n_i - 1) else output_line == 'NO' for output_line, n_i, k_i in zip(output_lines, n_list, k_list))
postconditions.description: For each test case, 'YES' is output if k_i is at least 2^(n_i - 1), otherwise 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line == 'YES' and len(output_line.split()) == 2 and int(output_line.split()[1]) == n_i - 1 if k_i >= 2**(n_i - 1) else True for output_line, n_i, k_i in zip(output_lines, n_list, k_list))
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is output, it is followed by the log_2 of the side length of the squares forming the path, which is n_i - 1.
